company.title: Your Solar DC & Low Voltage Supply Partner
company.intro1: Based in Wenzhou — China's electrical manufacturing capital — TPKELE engineers and manufactures certified protection devices for solar PV and low voltage distribution projects worldwide.
company.intro2: Our facility covers the full production cycle from mold tooling and injection to assembly, testing, and packaging. Every batch undergoes 100% electrical verification before shipment.
company.highlight1: In-house production with full QC traceability
company.highlight2: OEM/ODM capability — custom logo, label, and packaging
company.highlight3: IEC, TUV, CE and CB certified product lines
